consent: Brice confirmed on Oct 13, 2026 that he holds consent from everyone photographed. Names are never stored here: who is in a photo lives in the database (collective_person_tags), where hiding a profile or removing a tag takes effect everywhere.
how_to_use: Pick by "uses" and "orientation"; crop around "focal" (0–1 from the top left).
Use the 2400 file for full-bleed heroes, 1200 for cards and essays, 600 for thumbnails.
Use the alt text as written, or write a better one for the context. Never describe bodies.
Do not recolor, composite or generate on top of these photos. Black-and-white conversion of a color photo is allowed for a page that needs it.
Record which page uses a photo in "used_on" when you ship it.

tag_schema.note: Person tags moved to the database on Oct 13, 2026 (collective_person_tags.library_id = this id). Keep "tags" empty.
